refinement.side_surface: one C2 shoulder curve and regular crowned side section; retained factory Y/Z silhouette and upper body
refinement.fitted_hood_height_reference: replacement bonnet evaluated in the original attachment domain
refinement.hood: 2018 Challenger Demon deck, open forward Air-Grabber scoop and two recessed extractors
refinement.panel_joins: common side coordinates and tangents across factory panel seams; bonnet attachment and upper body retained
refinement.contours: explicit producer-authored ribbon pairs, baked offline into native pixel-coverage attributes
refinement.glazing: single exterior pane skins; one measured tangent field per pane

refinement.nose_transform: shared extension with a broader reference front, downturned bonnet crown and coplanar rounded optical carrier
